pageData.heroHeading: Help Business Owners Get Home Loans Faster
pageData.heroParagraph:
Many self-employed customers face loan rejections due to income assessment challenges, limited documentation, or lender policy restrictions.
DigitalDSA helps DSAs identify suitable lenders, evaluate eligibility, and improve approval chances for business owners, shopkeepers, traders, professionals, and MSME customers.

items.title: Have a Self-Employed Customer?
items.desc: Get lender recommendations based on business profile, income pattern, and available documentation.

items.title: Handling a Complex Case?
items.desc: Discuss difficult files with our specialists and discover alternative lender options.

items.title: Higher Approval Probability
items.desc: Find lenders whose policies match the customer's actual profile. We help you identify the right fit, increasing the chances of approval for self-employed customers.

items.title: Support for Non-Standard Income Cases
items.desc: Serve customers with low-profit ITRs, cash businesses, or inconsistent income. We help you navigate these challenges and find lenders that consider alternative income assessments.

items.title: Multiple Banks & NBFCs
items.desc: Expand beyond your existing lender relationships. We connect you with a wide network of banks and NBFCs that offer home loans to self-employed customers, giving you more options to serve your clients effectively.

items.title: Faster File Movement
items.desc: Reduce time spent checking lender eligibility manually. We provide quick insights on which lenders are likely to approve a file, allowing you to move files faster and improve customer satisfaction.

items.title: Expert Case Assistance
items.desc: Get support for challenging self-employed files. Our specialists can help you strategize and find solutions for cases that may not fit traditional lending criteria.

items.title: Grow Monthly Disbursements
items.desc: Close more cases and increase revenue. By improving approval rates for self-employed customers, you can grow your monthly disbursements and build stronger relationships with your clients.

homeLoanOptions.heading:
Business Owner Customer

items.title: Established Business Owners
items.desc: Customers with ITRs and financial statements. We help you identify lenders that consider their income and business stability for home loan approvals.

items.desc: Customers with limited operating history. We assist in finding lenders that evaluate current income and growth potential, even without extensive financial records.

items.title: Small Vendors & Informal Businesses
items.desc: Shopkeepers, traders, mechanics, electricians, service providers, and local businesses. We help you connect with lenders that accept alternative documentation and assess cash flow for home loan eligibility.

items.desc: Doctors, architects, consultants, freelancers, and other self-employed professionals. We guide you to lenders that understand the unique income patterns of professionals and offer suitable home loan options.

guide.heading:
Handling Customers With
Limited Documentation
guide.para:
DigitalDSA helps DSAs evaluate alternative lending opportunities when customers do not have complete financial records.
  • Alternative Assessment Methods
    - Bank statement analysis
    - Cash-flow evaluation
    - GST-based assessment
    - Surrogate income programs
    - Banking behavior review
  • Alternative Documents- GST returns
    - Shop establishment certificate
    - Utility bills
    - Business invoices
    - Bank statements

getStart.heading: How to Get Started
getStart.para:
For individuals like shopkeepers, small vendors, or repair workers with no financial records:
  • Step 1: First Time Free Consultation
    Speak with our Loan Specialists to discuss your needs and financial situation.
  • Step 2: Check Your Eligibility
    Use our Home Loan Eligibility Calculator or connect with us to get a quick estimate.
  • Step 3: Submit Documents Provide the necessary financial or alternate documents based on your business type.
  • Step 4: Choose Your Loan We’ll match you with the best lenders and guide you through the application process.

documentsGuide.para: Documentation requirements vary by lender and customer profile.

subList.list: ITR (Income Tax Returns) for the last 2–3 years (if available).
Computation of income and profit & loss statements.
Bank statements for the last 6–12 months.

lists.heading: For New or Unorganized Business Owners

subList.list: Bank statements for 6–12 months to assess cash flow.
Any business-related documents like a GST certificate, shop registration, or invoices.
A declaration of your income (self-declared income affidavit).

left.heading: Interest Rates PA
lists: Starting from 8.10% p.a. for new home loans.

right.heading: Fees (10-15k)

thinkKnow.heading: Things you should know
paraGraph: Independent Facilitator: Digital DSA serves as an independent loan facilitator, helping business owners connect with licensed banks and NBFCs for home loan solutions. We do not provide loans directly and are not a financial institution.

Loan Approval: Home loan approval for business owners depends entirely on the respective bank or NBFC's assessment of financial stability, income consistency, and creditworthiness. Digital DSA does not guarantee approval, as decisions are based on the lender’s policies, terms, and conditions. Interest rates, repayment options, and processing fees may vary accordingly.

Liability: Digital DSA is not responsible for any delays, rejections, or financial losses encountered during the loan application process. The final approval decision rests with the bank or NBFC, and their terms will apply.

Important Information: The details shared on this page are for informational purposes only and may not be suitable for every business owner. Home loan eligibility and benefits depend on various factors, including income stability, business history, and lender requirements. Exclusive loan offers may be available through Digital DSA, subject to specific eligibility criteria.

accordions.question: What if I don’t have ITRs or profit & loss statements?
accordions.answer:
We can work with alternative documentation, such as:
  • Bank statements showing cash flow.
  • Self-declared income affidavits.
  • Business-related certificates or invoices.

accordions.question: Can I still apply if my business is less than a year old?
accordions.answer: Yes! We have solutions tailored for new businesses based on current income and growth potential.

accordions.question: What’s the maximum loan amount I can get?
accordions.answer: Loan amounts depend on factors like your business cash flow, property value, and lender policies. Our Loan Specialists will help you estimate your eligibility.

accordions.question: Can I combine my home loan with financing for my business?
accordions.answer: Absolutely! We can help you explore options to combine your home and business loan financing for better management and savings.
